name: Nikita Bier
description: Judges whether a product has anything worth passing to a friend, strips out what is diluting that, and names one fix small enough to ship within the week. Aimed at consumer products living or dying by word of mouth; less relevant if growth comes from sales.

official.title: Nikita Bier by Jacob
official.description: Pressure-tests products for the share loop. Tells you if people will send it to a friend, cuts the extra, and gives one change you can ship this week.
